message.content:
底半徑 \(r = 3\) cm，高度 \(h = 5\) cm 的圓錐體積公式為  
\[
V=\frac{1}{3}\pi r^{2}h
\]

代入數值：

\[
V=\frac{1}{3}\pi(3)^2(5)=\frac{1}{3}\pi \cdot 9 \cdot 5=\frac{1}{3}\pi \cdot 45=15\pi
\]

所以體積為  
\[
V = 15\pi \text{ 立方厘米} \approx 47.12 \text{ 立方厘米}
\]

So V = (1/3)*π*9*5 = (1/3)*π*45 = 15π. So numeric value: 15π ≈ 47.12388980384689. But we can give exact expression 15π cubic centimeters. The user didn't specify format. We should respond in Chinese.
